text: Mujhe 3 din se bukhar aur khansi hai, paracetamol le raha hoon.
Meri 5 saal ki beti ko 2 din se pait dard aur ulti hai. Koi dawai nahi di. Penicillin se allergy hai.
I have had a headache for a week. I take ibuprofen sometimes. No allergies. I have high blood pressure.
Mujhe seene mein dard hai aur saans lene mein takleef hai, subah se.
Peshab mein jalan hai 4 din se, aur kamar mein dard. Sugar ki dawai metformin leta hoon.
Meri maa ko chakkar aate hain, 1 hafta se. Wo BP ki goli leti hain, naam yaad nahi.
